question: How do the senses follow the mind during the yogin's transfer into another body?
premises: Bees rise when their king rises and settle when he settles.
The mind leads the process of transfer.
The activities of the senses depend on the mind.
inference: Therefore, all sense activities follow the mind just as bees follow their king.
plain_english: Just as bees rise when the bee-king rises and settle when he settles, so all the activities of the senses follow the mind.
